hero.title: File:Palacio del Marqués de Cerralbo (Madrid) 01.jpg
hero.description: Façade of Cerralbo Museum, at 17 Calle de Ventura Rodríguez (street) in Madrid (Spain). Building was designed by architect Alejandro Sureda and built between 1883 and 1893 as a mansion for Enrique de Aguilera y Gamboa (1845–1922), 17th Marquis of Cerralbo. It was inaugurated as a museum in 1944, and declared an Artistic Historical Monument in 1962.
